sentences.text:
2024 
Author: K. Lakshman
Bench: K. Lakshman
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice K. Lakshman
 Writ Petition No.27877 of 2024
Order:

Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayath Raj, appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 4, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue, appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 3 and Sri P.Kishore Rao, learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent Nos.5 and 6.

2. Petitioner No.1 is claiming that he is the absolute owner and possessor of land admeasuring Ac.0-1750 gts., in Sy.No.734/1, Ac.0.1750 gts., in Sy.No.734/1, Ac.0-0200 gts., in Sy.No.734/2 and Ac.1-30 gts., in Sy.No.736/1, total admeasuring Ac.2-27 gts., petitioner No.2 is claiming that he is the absolute owner and possessor of land admeasuring Ac.0-19 gts., in Sy.No.730/1, Ac.1-20 gts.,
in Sy.No.733/A, Ac.0-1725 gts., in Sy.No.734/2, Ac.0-1725 gts., in Sy.No.734/2, KL,J Ac.0-02 gts., in Sy.No.734/ 3 and Ac.2-13 gts., in Sy.No.735/1, total admeasuring Ac.5-0850 gts., and petitioner No.3 is the absolute owner and possessor of land admeasuring Ac.0-0250 gts., in Sy.No.734/3/1, Ac.0-0200 gts., in Sy.No.734/4 and Ac.1-01 gts., in Sy.No.735/2/1, total admeasuring Ac.1-0550 gts., situated at Somarampet Repaka Revenue Village, Ellanthakunta Mandal, Rajanna Sircilla District.
In proof of the same, they have filed copies of the latest pattadar pass books and title deeds.

Even then, respondent Nos.2 to 6 are trying to lay a road from the subject property without following due procedure laid down under law including acquisition of land and payment of compensation in terms of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and financial sanction was also accorded for laying the said road.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thus, according to the petitioners, respondent Nos.2 to 6 are trying to dispossess the petitioners for the purpose of laying the KL,J said road without following due procedure laid down under law.

3. In the light of the same, this Court directed learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue,
learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayath Raj and learned Standing Counsel for respondent No.6, to get instructions.
All of them, on instructions, would submit that respondent Nos.2 to 6 will follow the due procedure laid down under law before taking action against the petitioners.
If the said property is required for any public purpose including laying of road they will follow due procedure laid down under law.

4. In the light of the said submissions and also considering the fact that the petitioners are the holders of the latest pattadar pass books and title deeds, this writ petition is disposed of directing Doragolla Komraiah, vs The State Of Telangana, on 4 October, 2024

1 respondent Nos.2 to 6 not to dispossess the petitioners from the subject property without following the due procedure laid down under law.

If the subject property is required for any public purpose KL,J including laying of road, liberty is granted to them to acquire the petitioners property by strictly following due procedure laid down under law.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in the Writ Petition shall stand closed.
